title: Correlation with a sign conjunction
statement: Choose signs $a,b\in\{−1,1\}$ independently and uniformly, and let their conjunction be $-1$ exactly when both are $-1$, and $1$ otherwise. The expected product of $a$ and this conjunction is $1/2$.
